svg.text: THE TWELVE LEVELS: WHAT EACH LEVEL FILE CONTAINS (COUNTS FROM THE FILES)
monsters: live records in the file (slots 1 to 29); items: records of ITEM.DAT placed on the level; triggers: cells with a script; timer: steps between level-timer
events (mode 2; level 1 off); stairs / falls out: levels reached by LOAD LEVEL, (+n) = n falling cells.
HOW THE LEVELS CONNECT (EVERY LOAD LEVEL IN THE SCRIPTS: 125 OF THEM)
falls (number of cells), one level down
